scorer: docxide-pdf metrics (Jaccard / text boundary), page_metrics.py port

unscored_page_size.reason: docxide-metrics leaves Jaccard and text boundary null when a candidate page and the Word page rasterise to different pixel sizes (orientation or paper size). These documents converted and score 0 here (intent-to-treat); the visual benchmark scores them. The sets differ by converter, so the cause is mostly the converter's page setup, not the Word PDF.
